integrity: The proof decomposes every increasing score into positive adjacent-cut indicators, computes their exact covariances with the ridit score, and combines the sharp ray correlations with the triangle inequality. The upper endpoint follows from Cauchy--Schwarz. Exact-rational computation replays the formulas and boundary constructions but does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The category probabilities are fixed and positive; only strictly increasing numerical scores vary.
The theorem concerns Pearson correlation with ridit scores, not power or optimality of a particular ordinal hypothesis test.
Older isotonic-cone or score-assignment literature may contain an equivalent angular formulation.
title: Sharp correlation floor between ordinal scores and their ridits
